summary: Engineering preview: native Instrument Teal HOME and Core/Sound/Texture/Groove banks now lead into shared-clock Groove/Loop/Mix/Click through SEQ. Loop has whole-phrase play once/repeat, explicit focus and an independent true cursor; Mix and Click edit real parameters. Two bounded pending lines distinguish queued idea/setup from applied state. External PLAY waits for pulses, clock loss releases scheduled ownership while preserving live HOLD and pending setup, and explicit Start/Continue resumes. Finite bank/page/chord transitions cancel with Motion Off. GLO > Legacy tools retains Recordings, Metronome and Drum grid. Existing manual takes and three-recording rotation remain in force. Full semantic Songs/editor, remaining page migration, motion hardware tuning and device verification are still pending. Milestone C now has a tested sixteen-slot semantic model, protected one-step draft/undo and checked v1 codec; native editor, scheduling integration and durable checkpoint remain pending.
